# Hockey Video Analyzer

> AI breakdown of hockey game film: upload footage, get timestamped feedback, grades, comparisons, and advanced statistics.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, stats, and recent submissions.
- [Upload](/upload): Add game footage for AI analysis.
- [Feedback](/feedback): Timestamped AI notes, category ratings, and overall grade.
- [Compare](/compare): Head-to-head stat table and skill radar chart.
- [Statistics](/statistics): Key metrics, grade trend, and shot heat map.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Player rankings by AI grade with profiles.
